criteria.finding: The supplied v0.02 package has no v0.03 frozen contract, declared rollback package, or completed successor evaluation yet.

Raw evaluation ledgers are empty, no denominator reconciliation exists, no evaluator recommendation exists, rollback package is absent, and the manifest omits several fields required by the v0.02 specification.
No gate outcome records exist from which prior critical gate passage can be reproduced.
The frozen contract SHA-256 matches the supplied manifest and no mutation evidence was found.
No promotion evaluation exists, so independent evaluator separation cannot be demonstrated for v0.02.

defects.summary: v0.02 cannot reproduce a promotion decision from raw records because the evaluation workspace is empty.
Schemas exist but there is no executable validator, semantic integrity checker, or test corpus.
The frozen-contract schema does not express failure conditions, promotion conditions, rollback expectations, integrity hash, or constrained metric record shapes.
v0.02 MANIFEST.json omits removed/deprecated capabilities, migrations, regression changes, preregistered goals, evaluation result, and promotion decision despite the v0.02 manifest specification.
Critical regressions are manual only and lack executable reproducible fixtures.
No v0.02 retrospective or rollback package exists although both are required by the protocol.

notes: v0.02 is structurally useful as an experimental governance parent but is not promoted/validated on the supplied evidence.
